content: Noritate is a topical cream that is commonly prescribed for the treatment of rosacea, a chronic skin condition often associated with adult acne. This condition is particularly characterized by persistent facial flushing, especially around the cheeks and chin. The active ingredient in Noritate is 1% metronidazole, an anti-inflammatory agent specifically formulated to reduce redness in inflamed areas of the skin. While Noritate can help eliminate some pustules and decrease redness, it has been observed to cause acne in a very small percentage of users. According to the drug information pamphlet, only 1% of users experience adverse effects. In many cases, however, users report no significant improvement in the overall redness associated with rosacea. In some instances, the condition may even worsen with the use of this medication. Similar outcomes have been reported with the use of Metrogel, another product that contains the same 1% concentration of metronidazole.
